title: Abbey of Our Lady of Atlas
geometryBasis: Native mapped masonry outlines, exact published entrance image, public-domain exterior view, monastery history and sourced hillside data.
sectionBasis: Ochre entrance gable with a clay-tile roof, barred upper opening, black paired gate and capped round pillars. Older masonry and paired hipped pavilions are visible on the garden-facing elevation. Floor heights follow the slope in steps.
limitations: Gate placement beside the downhill end of the attached mapped range and the subdivision of the garden elevation are inferred from the reference views and hillside geometry. Roof and storey heights are estimated.
Model covers the mapped attached masonry group. Detached agricultural and village buildings, interiors and gardens are outside this model.
